claim_scope: All Cartesian products of simple cycles of lengths at least three; the new aspect-ratio theorem concerns both cycle lengths at least five.
scientific_limitations_integrity: The main novelty claim is limited to rectangular (not necessarily square) Cartesian products. Foundational cycle values, the Cartesian fiber lemma, the general lower bound, and all square products are credited to published work. The 2024 paper on other graph products was compared only at abstract level. This is a mathematical proof with finite reproducibility checks, not independent certification of correctness or publication priority.
title: Exact monitoring edge-geodetic numbers of all rectangular discrete tori
